title: The step chain's home probe follows a redirect to the site itself, so a WordPress chain build reaches its write step
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: probeSiteHome follows a 301 from the container origin to the site's public address and reads the home healthy; a redirect to another origin stays unknown with that origin; a loop on the site's own address is unknown after three hops; the existing probe and recovery cases still hold.

tests: the home probe follows a redirect to the site itself (WordPress canonical), never one that leaves it
home recovery probes distinguish confirmed CMS failure from network and access failures
